Capability: Builds the 12x12 local Euler-Bernoulli stiffness of a two-node 3D frame element and rotates it to global axes from validated local axes.
Notes: No shear deformation. Rejects non-finite, non-positive, degenerate and badly oriented inputs through a typed error enum. No unit conversion.

Capability: Assembles element stiffness into a dense global matrix and reduces it for restrained and prescribed-displacement DOFs, adjusting the force vector.
Notes: Dense storage only; detects repeated restraints and invalid node indices.

Capability: Solves a small reduced linear system by deterministic dense Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting and reports singular systems.
Notes: Self-described interim path; internal zero-pivot guard is not a tolerance policy. Also serves as parity oracle for the sparse solver and as the dense scrutiny path.

Capability: Assembles caller-supplied 12x12 user stiffness macro-elements (oriented two-node elements) into the global stiffness alongside frame elements.
Notes: Used as the pattern for expansion-joint style elements and for the curved-bend slot; stiffness values are opaque caller data.

Capability: Fixes the six-DOF-per-node ordering and carries caller-supplied unit identifiers, canonical dimension names and model references alongside raw solver quantities.
Notes: Order is [ux,uy,uz,rx,ry,rz]; re-exported by the linear supports crate. Unit metadata only: no conversion, no defaults. Includes a force_per_length dimension label.

Capability: Turns explicit straight-pipe section properties into a frame element stiffness and computes weight per length from mass per length and gravity.
Notes: No dimension tables or material defaults. Boundary metadata binds fields to unit identifiers without conversion. The Python test exercises a boundary adapter emitting straight-pipe DTOs, not this crate.

Capability: Computes equivalent nodal loads for straight pipes from uniform local or global distributed loads over full or partial spans, point forces and axial effects.
Notes: Axial effect is a caller-supplied axial force; no load-case algebra.

Capability: Recovers straight-pipe local element forces, end resultants and station resultants or sweeps along the span from local or global displacements.
Notes: Many near-duplicate public variants (with/without spans, axial effects, global model). Mechanical resultants only; no stress classification.

Capability: Builds a two-node circular-arc bend element stiffness from a closed-form end flexibility scaled by user in-plane and out-of-plane flexibility factors.
Notes: Factors are validated opaque positive numbers; factor 1 reproduces a plain curved beam. No shear deformation. Consumed by the nonlinear loop as a stiffness slot.

Capability: Computes consistent nodal loads for a uniform distributed load on a bend arc and recovers section resultants at any arc fraction.
Notes: The crate README says formulation only with no recovery path, but the code does provide section-resultant recovery; the README looks stale.

Capability: Computes work-equivalent nodal loads for the internal-pressure radial wall load on a bend arc and section resultants including that pressure load.
Notes: Thrust magnitude is supplied by the caller; end-cap force pair is left to the caller.

Capability: Prepares anchors, guides, line stops, vertical supports, springs and imposed displacements as restrained DOFs, spring entries and prescribed values, then applies them.
Notes: Linear behaviour only. Support quantities carry dimension intent and optional unit identifiers without conversion.

Capability: Reports missing solve-required support data, duplicate restraints and invalid spring or imposed-displacement values as deterministic findings instead of defaults.
Notes: A blocked preparation stops application.

Capability: Classifies one-way, gap, lift-off and friction supports as active, inactive, sticking or sliding from trial displacements and reactions each iteration.
Notes: State-switched test: engaged supports classify on reaction sign, released ones on penetration or gap clearance. Gap and friction values validated at use time. Does not solve the system.

Capability: Produces a report-facing active-set record of iteration settings, support states, changes, diagnostics, assumptions and limitations.
Notes: Also maps nonlinear support errors and iteration-limit exits to solver diagnostics.

Capability: Runs the nonlinear support loop: reassembles stiffness, applies base and active restraints, solves, rebuilds displacements and reactions, iterates to active-set convergence.
Notes: Residual is the active-set state-change count; caller must supply the iteration cap and tolerance. Includes user-stiffness and curved-bend slots. Python test only inspects source text.

Capability: Applies a bounded plus/minus mu*N tangential force at friction supports classified as sliding, using explicit or derived normal reactions.
Notes: No path or load-step friction history. A sliding state seeded before any solved iterate defers convergence one iteration.

Capability: Selects the linear solve path per run: sparse profile solve by default, dense by explicit choice, falling back to dense when the sparse solve fails, with recorded evidence.
Notes: Mode strings sparse_interactive and dense_scrutiny are also used by the desktop solve path. The sparse crate README and frame kernel README still say the product path is dense; they look stale.

Capability: Adds validated linear ground springs to the nonlinear loop and determines contact DOFs eligible for contact-only initialisation.
Notes: Compatibility adapter; spring entries are (global DOF, stiffness) pairs in canonical units.

Capability: Guarantees that every non-converged or capped nonlinear exit carries a visible nonconvergence failure diagnostic, with assembled-loop assumptions and limitations.
Notes: Covers the zero-residual capped corner case at max_iterations 1.

Capability: Orders DOFs by deterministic reverse Cuthill-McKee over an adjacency graph or matrix nonzero pattern to reduce bandwidth and profile.
Notes: Tie-breaks by (degree, index); no randomness or threading. Zero external dependencies.

Capability: Stores a symmetric matrix in skyline profile form and solves it by in-repo LDL-transpose factorisation with permutation back to the caller's numbering.
Notes: Reads only the lower triangle; symmetry is the caller's contract. No pivot reordering. Bitwise repeatable.

Capability: Reports sparse factorisation outcomes: singular pivots located in both ordered and original numbering, nonpositive pivot count and a pivot-ratio conditioning proxy.
Notes: Pivot ratio is a documented proxy, not a true condition number. No thresholds encoded.

Capability: Defines solver diagnostic records (code, severity, source, class, remediation, provenance, references, units) and maps solver status to analysis-boundary status and authority.
Notes: Solver statuses map only to model-incomplete or mechanics-solved under solver-result authority; never rule-check or human statuses.

Capability: Converts frame-kernel, sparse-solver, linear-support and primitive-load errors and findings into located solver diagnostics.
Notes: Depends on a primitive-loads crate outside this inventory area.

Capability: Classifies a condition ratio as ok, ill-conditioned or failed against caller thresholds and emits convergence or nonconvergence diagnostics for iterative methods.
Notes: Thresholds are caller-supplied; none are defined here.

Capability: Emits standing status diagnostics saying sparse default adoption and solver tolerance policy are still unresolved.
Notes: Placeholder-state diagnostics; message text may lag the nonlinear loop, which already defaults to sparse.

Capability: Runs repeatable dense and sparse solves over invented cantilever-chain and grid-frame fixtures and records size, residual, conditioning, parity, timing and storage observations.
Notes: Measurement harness with no product path; asserts no timing or memory thresholds. Rejects fixtures without public provenance.

Capability: Produces sparse evidence records: suitability over invented grid size bands, and a nine-observation default-promotion packet with timing, hardware data and true condition numbers.
Notes: Suitability status uses bounded parity, residual, repeatability, pivot and pivot-ratio limits. The example binary emits the promotion packet. Python tests read source text and a retained packet; they do not run the harness.

Capability: Builds and classifies storage metadata records by storage context, record kind, privacy class, redistribution and review status into allow, warn or block decisions.
Notes: Metadata only: never reads or writes files, opens SQLite or transmits. Symbolic storage locality classes, no real paths.

Capability: Guards a set of storage records: blocks private payloads in public or shared contexts, requires explicit local-private intent and withholds cloud, SQL, secret and path details.
Notes: Public repository locality blocks even with local-private intent.

Capability: Admits an export route only if its identifier is on a fixed governed allowlist and its export context is valid, applying local-first storage rules from route metadata.
Notes: Unknown route IDs fail closed. The allowlist is hard-coded; payload-carried intent is ignored.

Capability: Returns a redacted copy of a report or export payload, redacting, omitting or blocking private, unknown or protected items per export context without mutating the source.
Notes: Local-private export needs explicit intent and still warns. Works on parsed dicts and lists only; no sensitivity inference from value text.

Capability: Wraps a fixed export route: strips payload-carried intent, projects values into metadata, redacts, adds local-first evidence and materialises output only when nothing blocks.
Notes: Optional lossless mode blocks if any value would be redacted or omitted. Blocking source findings also block.

Capability: Creates metadata-only references for private libraries, private paths, secret fields and credential placeholders without storing values or payloads.
Notes: Credential placeholder uses a fake key id and descriptor only. Concrete path detail is withheld.

Capability: Classifies secret and private-library references and decides whether they may be released to public, shared, downstream or local-private contexts.
Notes: Public reports may keep reference metadata with a warning; payloads, secret values and unknown rights are blocked.

Capability: Resolves telemetry configuration to disabled unless it carries explicit opt-in, an approved consent surface and allowlist evidence.
Notes: Absent, empty, malformed or incomplete configs all resolve to disabled; prebuilt enabled configs are rechecked.

Capability: Checks a telemetry event attempt before any payload is built, dropping disabled, unknown, non-allowlisted, payload-shaped or forbidden-field events.
Notes: No transport, vendor, queue or persistence exists; forbidden classes include private paths, hashes, report content, secrets and claim fields.

Capability: Validates a format-neutral adapter declaration: identity, framework status, open decisions, capability allowlist, provenance, validation plan and forbidden terms or persistence access.
Notes: Outcomes are accepted, rejected or quarantined; concrete file-format selection and direct persistence access are rejected. Parses no real formats.

Capability: Quarantines adapter declarations carrying protected-suspected content, protected privacy markers or uncleared provenance, taking precedence over other malformed fields.
Normalises untrusted adapter payloads into a bounded exact-JSON snapshot, rejecting hostile subclasses, cycles, excess depth, size or non-finite values with sanitised paths.
Notes: Hardening layer shared by declaration validation and plugin verification.

Capability: Gates adapter runtime dispatch so that even a valid declaration is never executed because no adapter runtime is selected.
Notes: Always returns a blocked outcome; no executor argument exists. Effectively a placeholder until a runtime exists.

Capability: Builds a deterministic adapter operation-result envelope with diagnostics, contexts, privacy and provenance, plus invented provenance and professional-boundary helpers.
Notes: Described as for tests and callers.

Capability: Verifies an already-loaded plugin manifest against its schema and checks no-bypass controls, provenance, diagnostics, permissions, sandbox, privacy, entrypoints and quarantine.
Notes: Includes its own bounded JSON-schema mismatch checker and rejects weakened lookalike schemas. Never loads a plugin.

Capability: Checks adapter unit evidence against a caller unit catalog: quantity metadata, dimension compatibility, known units, finite values and provenance, failing closed.
Notes: Reached only through the composed verification entry point.

Capability: Verifies an adapter declaration and plugin manifest as a pair and derives the resulting privacy and provenance envelope while keeping runtime dispatch blocked.
Notes: Most restrictive boundary wins; missing privacy is review-required, not public.
